I requested the EDD documents anyway, so someone should check whether what's on file meets the EDD requirement. If the review can't be expedited, Compliance would need to decide whether an exception is possible.

The shift is closed with a handover note covering both leads.

The customer wants the account open by month end and was told the review is pending. The referral from a senior colleague and the quick-turnaround request do not change the EDD requirement. Suggest Compliance review the file if the EDD cannot be expedited.
